title: EQ Curve
description: A ten-band graphic EQ for Taxman. Drag a band and the glowing curve bends through it while the spectrum behind it plays the change; pick a preset named after a Beatles album and the whole curve morphs into its shape, colour and all.
intent: A music-app equaliser built like it ships, with one over-the-top flourish: album presets that morph the curve and recolour the light.
